description: This Java source file defines the MockCluster class, which simulates a device cluster for testing purposes. It includes methods for reading and writing attributes, handling commands, and managing reporting configurations, with specific focus on Zigbee device interactions.

classes.name: MockCluster
classes.description: A class that simulates a Zigbee device cluster for testing, providing attribute management, command handling, and reporting functionalities.

classes.name: MockCluster.DataType
classes.description: A static inner class defining constants for various data types used in attribute data.

methods.name: getClusterName
methods.description: Returns the name of the cluster.

methods.name: getEui64
methods.description: Returns the EUI64 identifier of the device.

methods.name: getEndpointId
methods.description: Returns the endpoint ID.

methods.name: getClusterId
methods.description: Returns the cluster ID.

methods.name: isServer
methods.description: Indicates whether the cluster is a server.

methods.name: readAttribute
methods.description: Reads the attribute with the specified ID.

methods.name: readMfgAttribute
methods.description: Reads a manufacturer-specific attribute.

methods.name: writeAttribute
methods.description: Writes data to an attribute.

methods.description: Retrieves attribute data (stub implementation).

methods.name: setAttributeData
methods.description: Sets attribute data (stub implementation).

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute with specified ID and type.

methods.name: addMfgAttribute
methods.description: Adds a manufacturer-specific attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves attribute info by ID.

methods.name: getAttributeInfos
methods.description: Returns all attribute infos for a given manufacturer ID.

methods.name: getAttributeBytes

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Handles a command with given ID and payload (default logs error).

methods.name: handleMfgCommand
methods.description: Handles a manufacturer-specific command (default logs error).

methods.name: getReportingConfig
methods.description: Retrieves reporting configuration for a specific attribute.

methods.description: Sends an attribute report for a specific attribute.
